states.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a high-end warm royal 3D game environment still for KING LEO, AREA 1 CASTLE GATES — STATE 0 BEFORE REPAIRS. Portrait 9:16 composition for a mobile restoration game. A single charming castle gate occupies the central 75 percent of the image, seen straight-on at slightly elevated eye height with depth and physically based soft lighting. SAME GATE will be edited into later repair states, so create very clear stable construction: ONE large round sandstone arch with a central keystone enclosing a CLOSED but broken double oak door, two compact cylindrical cream sandstone towers on left and right with small royal-blue conical roofs and honey-gold tips. Chunky smooth bevelled blocks, broad simple seams, inviting fairytale 3D animation render quality, not photoreal gritty ruins. Central wall above the arch has a clear rectangular sandstone panel and a horizontal brass banner rod with two end knobs, EMPTY (no cloth). Two small EMPTY curved brass lantern hooks fixed on the stone piers just left/right of the arch at upper-door height; NO LANTERNS and NO LIGHT STRINGS yet. Broken door: weathered dark oak, both leaves sagging slightly inward, several large splintered/missing lower central planks, three loose timber fragments on threshold, old broad iron horizontal straps attached; no portcullis. This damage will be repaired in step 1, then banner hung in step 2, then lanterns added step 3. Cobblestone forecourt occupies lower quarter, tiny quiet grass tufts at stone bases, soft distant palace walls and trees visible on each far side, warm pale blue sky and soft clouds top quarter. Late-afternoon honey sunlight from upper left; warm cream/gold palette with royal blue roofs, soft grounded cast shadows and ambient occlusion. Fixed camera, symmetric layout, no characters, no workers, no text or interface, no logos, no floating symbols, no stars or magical effects in this still. Keep every tower roof and full gate in frame with margin. ONE image, no panels or collage. This is a stable base scene for successive small local edits, not four different buildings.

Use case: precise-object-edit. This is STATE 1: FIX THE TIMBER of the SAME King Leo gate in the reference image. Edit ONLY the wood inside the arched doorway and the loose broken wood on the threshold. Replace the rotted splintered oak planks with freshly repaired honey-oak vertical timbers. Both door leaves now hang straight, meet at a crisp vertical centre seam, fully closed with no gaps or broken holes. Retain the SAME four dark horizontal metal strap hinges, in their exact existing positions, and original arched door profile. The fresh oak is warm amber with broad simple wood grain, rounded edges, clear 3D depth, soft reflections, natural game-quality material. Remove the three loose timber fragments on the threshold now the repair is finished. Absolutely EVERYTHING ELSE is invariant: same stone arch, keystone, towers, royal-blue roofs, clouds, background castle, grass, paving stones, camera, crop, perspective, stone texture, lighting and shadows. Banner rod above arch stays EMPTY. Both brass lantern hooks remain EMPTY: no banner, no lanterns or lights yet. One final completed repaired-gate state, no collage, no animation effects or text. Preserve exact original image dimensions and registration.

Use case: precise-object-edit. STATE 2: HANG THE ROYAL BANNER on this EXACT SAME ALREADY REPAIRED GATE. Change ONLY the empty rectangular sandstone panel and brass banner rod above the keystone. Add a rich royal-blue silk heraldic banner hanging from this existing horizontal rod, with a broad honey-gold hem and one simple large embossed GOLD CROWN EMBLEM at its centre. Its width nearly fills the rectangular panel under the rod; its bottom ends above the arch keystone, NEVER covers any part of the wooden door. The fabric hangs from small loops on the same rod and drapes with soft 3D cloth folds, a gentle shallow swallowtail/point along bottom. Royal blue, warm gold, friendly regal design, no lettering. The repaired honey-oak closed double door and all four dark metal straps MUST stay exactly as they are. Both side lantern hooks stay EMPTY, no lanterns or lights yet. Preserve all other pixels/design as closely as possible: the exact stone blocks, two blue roofs, towers, sky, courtyard, trees, paving, camera, framing, lighting, and shadows. No redesigning or moving the building. Same dimensions and registration as input, one completed stage image, no collage, no labels.

Use case: precise-object-edit. STATE 3: HANG AND LIGHT THE LANTERNS on this EXACT SAME repaired gate WITH ITS ROYAL BANNER ALREADY HANGING. Change ONLY the two EMPTY brass wall hooks on the stone piers flanking the arch at mid-door height: suspend one matching warm BRASS AND GLASS LANTERN from each existing hook, left and right. Each lantern is a beautifully rounded square palace lantern, small pitched gold cap, four warm glass panes, visible amber candle glow, hanging ring attached physically to the existing curved brass hook. The lanterns should be medium-sized and clearly readable on a phone, roughly the height of two sandstone courses. Cast a gentle LOCAL warm amber glow on the adjacent stone only. Keep afternoon sky and overall scene lighting EXACTLY unchanged, do not switch to night. Crucial cumulative continuity: retain the exact already-repaired CLOSED honey-oak door, four dark metal straps, and the same royal-blue/gold crown banner in their exact positions. Do NOT remove or redesign the banner. Keep all towers, roofs, background castle, stone block details, trees, ground, shadows, camera, crop, and framing identical. No other decorations or new objects, no text, no particles in this completed-state still. One image at same dimensions and registration as reference.

motionAttempt.prompt: Create a premium 3D-style mobile game restoration animation preview for King Leo, Area 1 Castle Gates. Deliver a single continuous roughly 15-20 second video covering the user's three cumulative repair objectives: fix the timber of a broken gate; hang a royal banner on that repaired gate; then hang and light lanterns on the repaired gate that still has the banner. Essential: SAME SINGLE GATE MODEL, same environment, exact same locked camera, stonework, perspective, and framing throughout; previously completed repairs must persist. Begin with the broken gate, clearly show tangible beams assembling and settling into place, then a folded royal blue gold-edged banner physically being hoisted and unfurling, then two brass lanterns hanging from their brackets, swinging briefly and warming to amber light. These must be actual visible 3D movements with depth, cast shadows and cloth/pendulum motion, not crossfades of still pictures or a slideshow. No workers or characters required; a subtle magical restoration effect can drive the objects. Art direction: warm welcoming polished storybook 3D, honey-oak wood, cream sandstone blocks, blue and honey-gold royal colours, soft rounded bevels, sunset light. Gate design: one large arched double wooden door inside a symmetrical sandstone arch; a short round crenellated tower at each side with blue conical roofs visible; two small empty brass lantern brackets on the piers flanking the door; one horizontal banner rod over the top of the arch, empty initially. Door must remain CLOSED in every completed state. Banner is royal blue with a simple large gold crown emblem, and must hang above the doorway rather than obscure it. Cobblestone foreground, small quiet grass tufts, warm castle courtyard background; no environment renovation beyond the three objectives. Make an attractive portrait 9:16 game-area composition with the gate centred and the full scene visible. No UI, captions, text, voiceover, logos or watermark. Brief hold on each completed stage and on final fully restored gate. Generate the actual video asset for review, not instructions or only a storyboard.
